# Linefield S02 deletion amendment v4.1
PROPOSED AMENDMENT — NOT IMPLEMENTED OR SCHEMA-APPROVED, 2026-10-19.
The original regional v3 schema was approved in decision209; its tables are preserved below.
Decision236 approves durable-library sequencing and recoverable removal lifecycle, not these new mechanisms.
17 tables, 146 columns, 11 same-file relationships. Three namespaces represent separate SQLite files.
New catalog tables: removal_scopes, removals and departures. Drawing/jobs tables unchanged.
Stage preserves target bytes and Undo. Only an exact-set durable departure after destination readiness ends Undo.
No timeout finalization, persistent document edit Undo, new database or cross-file SQL foreign key.
Proposed scope ownership, acquisition reconciliation, bounds and partial SQL constraints require owner review.
See docs/database/deletion-v4/proposal.md for dictionary, sequence, migration and17 planned cases.
DBML is review documentation, not executable migrations. Exact browser lock/flush and generated contracts remain gates.
Private schema notes only; no drawing content, credentials or grants.

columns.database_incarnation: 16-byte instance UUID; changes on controlled replacement, not coordinator restart

columns.name_key: Stable machine key, not localized display text

columns.mutation_revision: Resulting content revision of last stroke mutation; fresh on Undo restoration
columns.base_width: Logical units before transform; CHECK(value BETWEEN 1 AND 512)
columns.placement_region_x: Signed i64 region address; Rust checked arithmetic
columns.placement_region_y: Signed i64 region address; positive Y down
columns.placement_local_x: Finite canonical local offset; CHECK(0 <= value AND value < 65536); +0
columns.placement_local_y: Finite canonical local offset; CHECK(0 <= value AND value < 65536); +0
columns.uniform_scale: CHECK(value BETWEEN 0.015625 AND 64); original points and base width preserved

columns.sample_index: Nonnegative contiguous from 0; sample 0 is derived immutable source anchor
columns.region_y: Signed i64 original region address; positive Y down
columns.local_x: Finite canonical local offset; CHECK(0 <= value AND value < 65536); +0
columns.local_y: Finite canonical local offset; CHECK(0 <= value AND value < 65536); +0

columns.operation_id: 16-byte command UUID; private committed outcome only
columns.client_session_id: 16-byte authenticated-session binding; not itself a credential
columns.owner_generation: 16-byte generation under which command was admitted
columns.command_kind: add_stroke, move_stroke, scale_stroke, delete_stroke, undo, redo, rename
columns.argument_fingerprint: 32-byte private validated-argument digest, never exported or logged

columns.activity_highwater: Local monotonic gallery activity allocator; never use wall-clock time

columns.database_incarnation: Last observed drawing incarnation; repairable projection
columns.managed_file_id: Opaque app-managed locator; not a display name or source path
columns.activity_order: Persistent local activity ordinal; descending order, timestamps remain independent

columns.center_region_x: Signed i64 saved viewport-center region; device-local preference
columns.center_region_y: Signed i64 saved viewport-center region; positive Y down
columns.center_local_x: Finite canonical local offset; CHECK(0 <= value AND value < 65536); +0
columns.center_local_y: Finite canonical local offset; CHECK(0 <= value AND value < 65536); +0

columns.width: Maximum untransformed pen width; CHECK(value BETWEEN 1 AND 512)

columns.expected_database_incarnation: Required for existing-file operations; nullable before new-file staging

columns.source_database_incarnation: Captured source instance; independent snapshot has its own incarnation

columns.access_reference: Bounded host-native bookmark/grant; no generic command codec
columns.target_identity: Bounded native identity, NULL if no target existed

catalog.removal_scopes.note: Current scope/fencing state, NOT a durable Create/Claim request receipt. One verified runtime grant holder. Lost acquisition results use live bounded request lookup or Unknown followed by verified retirement and fresh claim; never infer grant from row existence/generation. See proposal.md. No persisted credential or timeout takeover.

columns.scope_id: UUID length16; runtime-created gallery visit, never a bearer capability
columns.catalog_incarnation: UUID length16; Rust matches current library incarnation
columns.claim_generation: Nonnegative i64; checked increment on exclusive claim
columns.state: CHECK open or committed; transitions validated in Rust

catalog.removals.note: SQL partial UNIQUE(document_id) WHERE state IN (staged,finalizing) is required but not expressible here. Stage preserves existing drawings row/name/activity position. Terminal receipts survive drawing deletion. SQL state-dependent null CHECKs and Rust transaction checks are specified in proposal.md.

columns.stage_fingerprint: 32-byte versioned canonical semantic request digest; private
columns.document_id: UUID length16; logical drawing reference, no SQL FK
columns.managed_file_id: UUID length16; immutable managed target, no path
columns.state: CHECK staged, restored, finalizing or cleaned; legal transitions Rust
columns.undo_fingerprint: 32 bytes; present iff restored together with undo_operation_id
columns.departure_id: UUID length16; present iff finalizing or cleaned

catalog.departures.note: Immutable acceptance receipt; one or more catalog.removals. Insert with exact members, scope closure and lifecycle cleanup intents in one catalog transaction. Lost reply queries this outcome; absence is not permission to replay.

columns.scope_id: At most one committed departure per scope
columns.argument_fingerprint: 32 bytes; binds canonical exact removal set and destination
columns.destination_document_id: UUID length16; logical validated destination, no cross-file FK
columns.result_scope_revision: Positive i64; matches committed closed scope
columns.removal_count: CHECK between 1 and 256; exact count/member equality checked in Rust transaction
